why: rc24: typing in the chat, share codes across versions

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc24 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

New: Persian typing in the chat. While the line holds Persian, the edit box shows the same text joined and in reading order (what is sent is unchanged).
New: share codes between versions. A code made by a newer version loads as far as yours understands it and tells you to update; a code from an older one keeps your own value for what it did not know.
Fix: the minimap tooltip wording.
Includes rc7 to rc23.
